_comment: RQ3 on the pin-index plate as built. Seven positions per side: the inner arm hole serves 0, 5, 10 and 15 degrees, the outer arm hole serves 3.5, 7.5 and 12.5 (read off the CAD and the plate; the first full run assumed 3, 7 and 12 and its data files were corrected afterwards, see ANGLE_CORRECTION.md in that session folder). Order changed 2026-09-29 from ascending to inner holes first, so the pin changes hole once per distance. Simulation with all seven positions gives a crossover interval of about 0.1 degree, so no new hardware is needed.
